text:
noah_csm: Kickoff: Runway Health pilot. Customer leads: Marta (product) + Diego (platform). Objective: replace FAQ routing with embeddings + chat-assisted triage. Target: pilot live in 30 days.

lina_se: Env Q — do they have strict egress policies? that'll change the onboarding checklist.

noah_csm: Marta says outbound to our hosted endpoints is allowed from their staging cluster; prod may require allowlist. We'll start hosted.

ash_enablement: Propose two enablement sessions: 1) integration & runbook, 2) evaluation & alerting. Who should attend from Runway?

noah_csm: Marta + Diego + 1 support SME + 1 analytics engineer. Prefer sessions in week 1 and week 3.

remy_successops: Risk note: renewal visibility low — pilot headcount limited. Set escalation triggers: <50% planned test traffic by D12 or eval pass <78%. Weekly traction summary to exec sponsor required.

lina_se: Tech checklist draft:
- API key exchange + allowlist steps
- Anonymized sample dataset (support transcripts)
- Golden-answer prompt set
- Staging traffic replay (8k requests)
- Target p95 latency <375ms

noah_csm: Draft timeline:
D0: kickoff + goals
D0–D6: env prep, keys, data handoff
D7–D13: integration + smoke tests
D14–D20: enablement workshops + eval runs
D21–D30: polish, exec checkpoint, go/no-go

ash_enablement: I'll prep runbook template and a 1-pager pre-read.

lina_se: I'll stand up a lightweight test harness and post curl/postman examples tonight.

onboard-bot: Meeting created: "Runway Health — Pilot Kickoff" 2024-06-10 09:30 PDT 1 invite sent to noah_csm, lina_se, ash_enablement, marta_runway.

noah_csm: Success criteria (confirm):
- Integration completed with sample dataset
- >=78% correctness on eval prompt set
- p95 latency <375ms in staging under replay
- Customer can run daily evals and see regression alerts

remy_successops: Add D30 decision: go/no-go + recommended commercial next step. I'll draft weekly traction email template.

noah_csm: Ownership:
- Integration: lina_se
- Enablement & runbook: ash_enablement
- Metrics & traction: remy_successops
- CSM owner: noah_csm

lina_se: ack. I'll also request transient logs & sample retention window from Runway.

ash_enablement: ack. I'll circulate invites for the workshops and include a one-question survey about their eval goals.

remy_successops: ack, adding risk flags to dashboard and wiring a D12 alert.

noah_csm: Action recap:
- lina_se: test harness + logs request (EOD)
- ash_enablement: runbook + pre-read (by Mon)
- remy_successops: weekly template + dashboard (by Wed)
- noah_csm: finalize kickoff agenda + confirm attendees (EOD)

lina_se: will do.

ash_enablement: will do.

remy_successops: will do.

noah_csm: Thanks team 64f3fb — will post notes after the call and attach the checklist.
